acquisition_method.evidence: For identifying new suitable diagnostic protein biomarkers bottom-up data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mass spectrometry-based approaches are most popular.
Recently, data-independent acquisition (DIA) emerged as an alternative method.
It overcomes several limitations of DDA, since it combines the benefits of DDA and targeted methods like selected reaction monitoring (SRM).
